caption: The drawing depicts a tall, vertically ribbed vase with a round base, wide belly, and a slightly narrower neck that flares out at the rim. The vase is primarily rendered in shades of brown and ochre, with subtle gradations to indicate curvature and depth. It features two handles, one on each side, which are colored in a greenish-blue hue and have an angular, squared-off shape extending outward before curving downward. Decorative foliage consisting of green stems and broad blue-green leaves, along with four round, brownish fruit or pods, rises up one side of the vase, creating an organic motif that contrasts with the vase’s geometric form. The background of the drawing is plain, off-white, and unadorned. A small signature is visible in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Amber Vase
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
